axis_policy: As-released xyz on each named ankle, identity matrix. Cross-study anatomical axis alignment UNVERIFIED. This is unit/rate-adapted zero-shot domain transfer, not fully harmonized validation. No rotation/sign search or target normalization.
resampling: Causal upfirdn, up=15/down=32, firwin(641,1/32,window=('kaiser',5.0))*15. Full FIR warmup only (k>=20), no right tail padding. Logical signal time t0+k/60-1/6, actual available time logical+1/6. Reset only at raw clock gaps; input NaN propagates and never fills missing gyro.
window: Same left-anchored 120 points, step30; right missing skips original grid. Native labels sampled by previous source cell only for weak-window labels; primary events evaluated at native128Hz with actual delayed availability.
selection: All 60 files in the fixed seven-person directory, no other duplicate sensor-set directory. No external retraining, calibration, threshold selection, augmentation, postprocessing or competing candidate scoring.
reporting: All source records and raw events, including missing-input records/events. Window P/R/F1/AP plus native event any-overlap, duration recall/precision, false-alarm duration and decision support, by person/record. No clinical efficacy, turn intention or step-success claims.
